Name: More TV Channels for George
Author: AirynS
Description:
It's no wonder George is grumpy - he's stuck watching the same channel on repeat every single day of the week! Now he has access to the same variety of channels that the farmer has. His TV will change what program is showing each hour, with Queen of Sauce and Livin' On the Land showing on their appropriate days, and will even turn off at night when he goes to bed.

For users who find the hourly rotation causes performance issues, a Daily option is also available, where George's TV channel will change each day instead of each hour. Queen of Sauce and Livin' On the Land will still show on their appropriate days and the weather report will show on bad weather days.

To install, simply extract the "[CP] More TV Channels for George" folder and drop it in your Mods folder.

This mod should be compatible with everything and has particular compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29589]Nicer Seasonal TV Channels [/url]- if it's installed, More TV Channels for George will match its seasonal Livin' On the Land and weather report channels!
